name: serve
summary: Run the project daemon (Engine Protocol on WebSocket, MCP at /mcp)
usage: ara serve [OPTIONS]

options.name: --port <PORT>
options.doc: Port on 127.0.0.1 (default: any free one, written to .ara/daemon.json)

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --stdio
options.doc: Also serve the Engine Protocol on stdin/stdout

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)
